translated_title: Confidence in Mexico Secures US Investment, Sheinbaum Says After Meeting With Business Leaders and Ambassador Johnson
original_title: Confianza en México asegura inversión de EU: Sheinbaum luego de reunión con empresarios y el embajador Johnson

meta_description: The executives, who came with Ambassador Ronald Johnson, pressed for a quick USMCA deal, while new pharma, energy and farm investments are on the way.
